item.title: Multiple Area Schools on Delays or E-Learning Today Due to Weather
item.description: All Daviess County Schools—Washington, Washington Catholic, Barr Reeve, and North Daviess—will be on a 2-hour delay today. Loogootee and Shoals will again be e-learning today, and school will be closed. Pike County Schools will be e-learning today.
